trend: Indian nutraceutical startup funding now estimated above $500M, while regulators tighten scrutiny
why: A Monday category take for X, in brand voice, that lines up with today's LinkedIn post.
text:
Funding into Indian supplement startups is now estimated at over $500 million, while regulators are tightening up at the same time.

More brands is good news for buyers, as long as the labels keep up. Our rule: if a dose isn't printed on the pack, we don't count it as a claim.
